hypothesis: Coulomb-response conditioned coherent orbital state for larger-basis constrained correlation
mathematical_primitives: Spin-paired determinants, polynomial cofactors and variational Ritz coefficients; these primitives are not claimed as novel
objective: Actual Hamiltonian Rayleigh quotient, no reference-energy loss
reference_retention: Unchanged input determinant always included; do not regularize its physical norm
assessment: One frozen run per case. Compare against saved new same-basis references only after optimization. Retain all failures; no mode/seed/iteration sweep to rescue a failure.
scope: Full larger-basis state experiment. Canonical density constraints and density-only frame still need integration.
symmetry: Exact particle number, fermionic antisymmetry and S=0 for spin-paired states. Orbital-rotation covariance is a property of the variational family; finite-optimizer spatial covariance is unverified.
limits: No claim of a world-first determinant method
Explicit component product closure still required
